history.description: Fixed TS2345 error in useAuth.ts by adding explicit storage schema types and index signatures. Unified storage keys with DashboardAPI ('dashboardAuthToken'). Verified with tsc.
Implemented Phase 2: All Platforms. Added ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Perplexity support. Implemented network interceptors, platform adapters, and DOM extractors with fallback logic. Verified build.
Scaffolded extension_v3. Implemented Gemini bridges (main/content/dom), background scripts (auth, dashboard API, message router). Copied legacy popup and assets. Build verified.
Fixed ESLint parsing error for vite.config.ts by switching to projectService in root eslint.config.mjs.
Fixed 26 ESLint errors in extension_v3: resolved import-order issues and replaced forbidden 'any' types with 'unknown'/safe casts.
